name: Paper invoice paid
oneLiner: a real printed invoice is slid onto a black leather desk pad under a warm lamp, the camera drifting in as the line items read down and the total counts up, then a green satin PAID ribbon slides over the top corner, the sheet gives a little and the amber due pill turns into a green Paid in full
say: when the speaker says the client paid or what one job billed ('they paid the invoice the same day', 'that one project was 2,400'): cut in on the amount, the ribbon lands on 'paid'
